content_sections.heading: UCSL Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: All three notifications share the same application window. Applicants are advised to submit applications well before the last date, as troubleshooting/technical support in the SAP application portal may not be available after 1600 hrs on the last date.

content_sections.heading: UCSL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: *Backlog vacancies. UCSL states that persons with benchmark disabilities (PwBD) have not been included for these posts as UCSL is engaged in hazardous operations that could put PwBD candidates at serious risk. *Backlog vacancy. PwBD candidates with Low Vision, Deaf and Hard of Hearing, or One Arm/One Leg/Both Leg/Leprosy Cured (without functional impairment)/Dwarfism/Acid Attack Victims (without other functional disability) may apply for the Supervisor (Finance) post only. PwBD candidates with Low Vision, Deaf and Hard of Hearing, or One Arm/One Leg/Both Leg/Leprosy Cured (without functional impairment)/Dwarfism/Acid Attack Victims (without other functional disability) may apply for Office Assistant, Draftsman (Mechanical), Draftsman (Electrical), and Store Keeper posts. Across all three notifications, UCSL reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, or not fill up any of the vacancies, or cancel the recruitment process, as per its requirement.

content_sections.heading: UCSL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee must be paid online via Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking (and, for Workmen posts, Wallets/UPI) through the official application facility. No other mode of payment is accepted, and candidature is considered only on receipt of the applicable fee.

content_sections.heading: UCSL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Objective Type Test (50 marks) + Personal Interview (20 marks) + PowerPoint Presentation on work experience (30 marks) = 100 marks total. The Objective Type Test is 60 minutes, 50 MCQs, covering General Knowledge (10 marks) and Subject-based questions (40 marks), with no negative marking. Minimum pass marks: 50% (UR/EWS), 40% (SC/ST for reserved vacancies). Phase I - Written Test: Objective Type (40 marks) + Descriptive Type (40 marks). Phase II - PowerPoint Presentation on work experience (20 marks). Total 100 marks. The Objective Test's General section (Part A) covers General Knowledge, General English, Reasoning, and Quantitative Aptitude (5 marks each), plus Discipline-related questions (20 marks). Minimum pass marks: 50% (UR/EWS), 45% (OBC for reserved vacancies), 40% (SC/PwBD). Offline Objective Type Test (70 marks: General 30 + Discipline-related 40) + Descriptive Type Test (Writing Skills, 30 marks) = 100 marks. Only candidates clearing the minimum Objective Test pass mark have their Descriptive answer sheets evaluated. Phase I - Offline Objective Type Test (30 marks, 35 minutes, covering General Knowledge, Quantitative Aptitude, and Trade-related questions). Phase II - Practical Test in the relevant trade (70 marks). Total 100 marks. For Workmen posts, minimum pass marks are: 50% (Unreserved), 45% (OBC for reserved vacancies), 40% (PwBD). Across all notifications, shortlisted candidates undergo certificate verification before proceeding to the next stage, and final rank lists are prepared based on aggregate marks, with tie-breakers based on subject/discipline marks and then seniority in age. No TA/DA is paid for attending the selection process.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UCSL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → UCSL, Malpe) or www.udupicsl.com (Career page) and review the User Manual and FAQ before applying. Complete the one-time Registration on the SAP online application portal. Fill in the online application for the relevant post, ensuring all fields are accurate - only one application per candidate is allowed, and submitted applications are final. Upload all required certificates (proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste/category, disability, etc.) along with a recent passport-size colour photograph. Pay the applicable application fee online (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking, and UPI/Wallets for Workmen posts), unless exempted. Submit the application and confirm the status shows "In process" under "My Applications." Retain a soft copy/printout of the application along with the system-generated unique registration number for future correspondence with UCSL. faq.question: Q1. What is UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It refers to three vacancy notifications dated 11 August 2026 issued by Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited (UCSL) for Assistant Manager, Supervisor, and Workmen posts on contract/fixed-term basis at UCSL, Kochi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 31 vacancies: 8 Assistant Manager posts, 13 Supervisor posts, and 10 Workmen posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application across all three notifications is 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from ITI/Diploma for Technician, Draftsman, and Supervisor (ITI-route) posts to a relevant Bachelor's Degree/Diploma for Office Assistant, Store Keeper, Supervisor (Finance), and Assistant Manager posts. See the Eligibility section above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Upper age limit is 30 years for Assistant Manager and Workmen posts, and 45 years for Supervisor posts, as on 01 September 2026, with category-wise relaxations detailed in the Eligibility section.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UCSL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹400 for Assistant Manager posts and ₹300 for Supervisor and Workmen posts, with SC/ST (and PwBD, for Supervisor/Workmen) candidates exempted.
